CRITICAL_SAFETY_AND_MEDICAL.description: In-flight/tarmac medical emergencies, severe turbulence injuries, active safety hazards, trapped passengers.
CRITICAL_SAFETY_AND_MEDICAL.action_policy: Bypass bot immediately. Alert dispatch and airport operations.

LEGAL_REGULATORY_DOT_COMPLAINT.description: Threats of litigation, formal FAA/DOT regulatory violations (14 CFR Part 259 tarmac rules, involuntary bumping rules), attorney notices.
LEGAL_REGULATORY_DOT_COMPLAINT.action_policy: Route to Legal/Regulatory Affairs. Do not generate automated legal advice.

ACCESSIBILITY_AND_ADA_CRITICAL.description: Damaged motorized wheelchairs/assistive devices, passenger left stranded without mobility aid, service animal denial.
ACCESSIBILITY_AND_ADA_CRITICAL.action_policy: Immediate Priority ADA escalation. Station manager alert.

SECURITY_AND_ACCOUNT_TAKEOVER.description: Compromised SkyMiles account, unauthorized points drain, credential stuffing, identity theft.
SECURITY_AND_ACCOUNT_TAKEOVER.action_policy: Lock account security status, route to Fraud Prevention.

VULNERABLE_PASSENGER_URGENCY.description: Unaccompanied minors stranded/unattended during disruptions, lost children, medical equipment/insulin trapped in delayed bags.
VULNERABLE_PASSENGER_URGENCY.action_policy: Immediate supervisor alert at transit hub.
